Adam Schiff led the House Intelligence Committee's impeachment inquiry, Trump deployed a sustained campaign of nicknames and personal attacks, calling Schiff 'Shifty Schiff,' 'Pencil-Neck Adam Schiff,' and 'Little Adam Schiff.' Trump mocked Schiff's physical appearance — his neck — at rallies to crowd cheers, and repeatedly accused him of 'treason,' at one point suggesting a punishment for Schiff that commentators interpreted as a death threat. The relentless attacks were part of a documented White House strategy to discredit and harass oversight officials as a form of obstruction.
